A.notes: Kingfisher seed mark, azulejo palette, clean and warm but conventional brand-guide template. Fails contrast (white caption over image 1.17:1, accent text 3.35:1), tiny 6.5-9px text, no reduced-motion rule. Photography are simple illustrations; applications modest. Few interactive states.

B.notes: Sunrise-over-calm-water concept carried through logo, hero rings, applications and a closing motion section. Serif/mono/sans system, rich logo misuse, contrast pairs, interactive tone and downloads. All audit gates pass. Very long on mobile and dense, with small mono text.

why: B passes every gate and is a deeper, more complete and more interactive brand system with a coherent sunrise concept. A is charming but fails contrast, tiny-text and reduced-motion gates and is more template-like.
